notes.title: 0.3.9 Patch Notes | Final Train Playtest Build
notes.content:
In the last news post, I talked about how this would be the final patch for 0.3, nicknamed "Train Playtest." I also talked about how I hoped this would be out before the new year. Whoops!

Regardless, here are the final patch notes for 0.3.

[u]Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Moved all tutorials back to the bottom of the screen to be more in-line with literally every other piece of text
[*] Moved money above the pause menu options
[*] Made Abriella's falling into bed cutscene a little longer
[*] Fixed a lighting issue in a cutscene with the detective
[*] Fixed the train station's lighting
[*] Fixed some bugs where loading a save file would mess with NPCs
[*] Changed how talking indicators work
[*] Changed dialogue with the conductor a little bit
[*] Rewrote some NPCs, notably the detective and NPCs related to the detective
[*] Rewrote the ending of the train area to actually make sense
[*] Other small stuff that you don't care about
[/list]

[u]Addition[/u]
[list]
[*] Discord rich presence. Now everyone will know what you're doing, you freak. When Demo 2™ releases, it'll be a bit more in-depth.
[/list]

notes.title: patch v0.3.8 - now here's the lighter
notes.content:
long time coming but shut up this is a big update

additions/big changes
[list]
[*]THE BIG THING: CHANGED THE LIGHTING. i already had a lighting plugin, but i was only using it for one thing(inside abandoned building), which is stupid. it's now used EVERYWHERE.
[*]added quest marker popup to detective and magician, as well as a talk marker to (most? i can't remember) npcs you can talk to.
[*]made the amount of money you currently have visible in the menu, as well as show up when that amount is changed
[*]im terribly sorry to all the fans of the child in the train station, but they have been removed.
[*]other stuff that i can't remember or is extremely insignificant
[/list]

fixes/small changes
[list]
[*]fixed conductor not moving back to proper location
[*]fixed timing of conductor's quest marker popup
[*]changed all tutorial dialogues to be in the center of the screen, so they now match with the journal tutorial
[*]made all tutorial dialogues unskippable for 3 seconds because if i have to see someone not know how to sprint one more time, i'm gonna crash out. (note: the [i]Disable Tutorials[/i] option is still available.)
[*]fixed shady guy sneezing. took me long enough
[*]fixed that (unintentionally) stupidly funny thing with the detective. iykyk.
[*]other stuff that i can't remember or is extremely insignificant
[/list]

happy november

[*]other stuff that i can't remember

notes.title: patch v0.3.6 notes
notes.content:
[h1]additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]added a tutorial of how the journal works upon receiving it.
[*]added a setting to disable tutorials.
[*]added a version number to the bottom right of the title screen.
[/list]

[h1]fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]lowered the volume of the sink in the ladies room. it [i]should[/i] be fine now. if it isn't, i may crash out.
[*]fixed the detective's quest breaking because of certain interactions.
[*]fixed the magician's quest not removing an item that it was supposed to.
[*]other tiny changes that you won't notice/care about
[/list]

happy halloween, testers!

notes.title: oct 28th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] christian found a game breaking bug to do with the window color changer, so i removed access to it.
[*] multiple people have missed the 2 side quests on the train, so i made it more obvious how to start them
[*] made all the seats on the top of the train sittable
[*] fixed an issue that nobody found because it was locked behind a side quest
[*] multiple people have expressed their speedrunning urges, so livesplit integration will be coming soon
[/list]

keep finding bugs y'all!
